summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its total voting rights and capital as of April 30, 2026, in compliance with the UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. The filing provides a breakdown of issued ordinary shares (7,972,514,364 excluding treasury), treasury shares (194,272,577), and preference shares (totaling 483,140 shares across two series). The aggregate total voting rights are 31,891,990,016. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of capital structure; it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or other special-situation event. The sole purpose is to notify shareholders and market participants of current voting rights for threshold calculations.
